in_sanskrit.name: दुर्गराम
in_sanskrit.meaning: difficult to reach, inaccessible, hard to obtain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Durgaram is derived from the words ‘dur’ meaning difficult and ‘garam’ meaning to reach or obtain. This name signifies that the one who bears this name is difficult to reach or obtain, and is inaccessible or hard to get. It is a powerful and evocative name, suggesting strength, determination, and the ability to overcome obstacles.

in_hindi.name: दुर्गराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Durgaram in Hindi translates to ‘kathin prapt’, meaning difficult to reach or obtain.

in_tamil.name: துர்க்கரம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Durgaram translates to ‘turkkaram’, meaning ‘appadi piraiku’, which can be translated as ‘difficult to approach’ or ‘hard to reach’.

in_telugu.name: దుర్గరామ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Durgaram in Telugu translates to ‘durgarāma’, which can be translated as ‘deshayōjana’, meaning ‘difficult to obtain’ or ‘hard to come by’.

in_marathi.name: Durgaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durgaram is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words ‘Durga’ and ‘Rama’. Durga signifies ‘the invincible one’, and Rama stands for ‘the one who delights the people’. Together, Durgaram signifies ‘God’s fortress’, ‘the abode of the divine’, or ‘the protector of all’. This name has been associated with strength, resilience, and the divine presence.
